# GitSentinel EDR
> Universal Behavioral Endpoint Detection & Response System for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS.

## Project Summary
GitSentinel is a host-based behavioral security system designed to detect and quarantine:
- AI Sandbox & Runtime Breakouts (e.g. Docker socket mounts, unauthorized host subshells).
- Ransomware (WannaCry-style mass file encryption, canary file triggers, volume shadow copy deletion).
- Covert Spyware & Surveillance ("CTRL" movie-style background screen recorders, keyloggers, credential theft).
- Network Worms (SMB port 445 / RDP 3389 lateral propagation).
- Unauthorized Git Commits and Headless Pull Request generation.

## Technical Architecture
- Ingestion Layer: Native macOS Unified Logging (`os_log`), Windows Sysmon (Event ID 1, 3, 4104), Linux auditd.
- Analysis Engine: Active vs. Passive operational profiler, MITRE ATT&CK TTP mapping, mutation & zero-day similarity scoring.
- Mitigation Layer: Instant native desktop notifications, automated SIGSTOP / SIGKILL process freeze, and local SQLite forensics (`sentinel.db`).
- Platforms Supported: macOS (Universal), Windows 10/11 (64-bit), Linux, iOS (PWA), Android (PWA).
